subject: Admin activity evidence: routing, retention tiers, and export options
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medicosys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — admin activity evidence (SIG/CAIQ) and export options

Hi Logan / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. MedicoSys is finishing our SIG/CAIQ review and we need an evidence package for admin activity (operator/admin actions, role changes, API key rotations, privilege escalations) covering the last 12 months. Our security team needs the following clarified before we kick off ingestion to our evidence system: 

- Exact event types you emit for admin activity (sample event names and fields).
- Retention tiers and the default retention windows for live vs archived traces.
- Export formats you can provide (parquet/jsonl/csv) and whether we can request compressed bundles with checksums.
- Delivery methods (S3 presigned URL, SFTP, encryption-at-rest with customer KMS).
- Chain-of-custody / signed manifest support and a HMAC/sha256 manifest for integrity.

Can you confirm whether you can produce a signed, time-bounded snapshot for: 2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31, and indicate estimated size and lead time? Also, our auditor will want a statement on timezone normalization (are timestamps in UTC, and do you preserve original TZs in the payload?).

If helpful, we can do a short call to align on the manifest schema — earliest availability for us is next Tuesday afternoon PT.

Best,
Audrey Chen
Director, Compliance Operations
MedicoSys

[MedicoSys: security@medicosys.com]
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medicosys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — admin activity evidence (SIG/CAIQ) and export options

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; I attached a compact sample manifest and a mapping CSV to illustrate field names.

Quick answers: 
- What we log: operator/auth events (login_success, login_failure), role changes (role_assigned, role_revoked), API key lifecycle events (api_key_created, api_key_rotated, api_key_revoked), session impersonation, and privileged action markers (privileged_action_start/complete). Each event includes timestamp_utc (ISO8601), principal_id, principal_type, action, target_resource, ip_address, request_id, and kv_diff (for changes).
- Timezone: all timestamps in the export are normalized to UTC (timestamp_utc). We preserve original offset in a source_offset field for forensic needs.
- Retention tiers: default active retention 90 days (hot), archived retention snapshots kept 7 years by policy for signed snapshots. We can provide shorter retention (30/90/365 days) on request as part of the export SLA.
- Export formats: parquet (columnar), newline-delimited JSON (jsonl), and gzipped CSV. Each bundle includes a signed manifest (manifest.sha256) and an HMAC file if you supply a verification secret.
- Delivery: S3 presigned URLs (preferred), SFTP over VPN (legacy), or customer-managed S3 with cross-account replication. Exports are encrypted at rest; we support customer KMS keys on Dedicated/Private plans. For hosted accounts we use server-side encryption and provide key-wrap metadata.
- Chain-of-custody: manifests include export_time, export_id, file_list with checksums, exporter_principal, and a signature block we can sign with our platform key. You can request a notarized timestamp via our signing authority for FID.

Lead time: full 12-month signed snapshot -> estimate 2 business days to prepare and 48 hours to stage (depends on size). Estimated compressed size: ~8–12 GB depending on sampling (I/O bound).

Questions before we prepare:
1) Do you require HSM-backed signature verification (we can provide X.509 signature chain) or is HMAC sufficient?
2) Are you ingesting into an S3 bucket in us-west-2 (please confirm ARNs) or would you prefer presigned deliverables?
3) Any PII redaction rules we need to apply before export?

If Tuesday PT works, Kimberly and I will join the call. I attached the sample manifest and export-sample-mapping.csv for your review.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: export-sample-mapping.csv]
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medicosys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, MedicoSys Compliance <security@medicosys.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — admin activity evidence (SIG/CAIQ) and export options

Thanks, Logan — the answers look good. A few clarifications: 

- HSM/X.509: We prefer signatures that can be verified against a certificate chain (auditor requirement). Can you provide signing cert metadata in the manifest?
- Delivery: We'll accept presigned S3 URLs to a MedicoSys staging bucket in us-east-1 (arn:aws:s3:::medicosys-evidence-staging). If presigned is not available for your hosted plan, we can accept a signed SFTP transfer.
- Redaction: We need email addresses redacted for exports older than 90 days unless otherwise requested. Keep a hashed_email field (sha256) in the payload.

We are available Tuesday 2026-06-23 at 2:00 PM PT for a 30-minute alignment meeting. Also attaching the auditor's ingestion checklist as a reference (see attachment).

Best,
Audrey

[Attachment: MS-Audit-Ingest-Checklist.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medicosys.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Admin activity evidence — proposed handoff plan and timeline

Audrey — looping back with a proposed, minimal-risk plan that meets the auditor requirements you shared. Deliverables and actions below.

Deliverables: 
- Signed snapshot bundle for 2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31 in parquet + jsonl. Files: admin-activity-parquet-part-*.parquet.gz, admin-activity-jsonl.gz, admin-activity-manifest.csv.gz, signed-manifest.sha256.
- Manifest includes: export_id, export_time_utc, signature_cert_subject, signature_cert_fingerprint, file_list (filename,size,sha256), exporter_principal (kimberly.park@redwood.com), timezone_note (timestamps normalized to UTC + source_offset preserved).

Handoff method: Generate bundles -> stage to a temporary, pre-authorized S3 bucket in us-east-1 -> provide presigned GET URLs valid 72 hours. We will provide SHA256 checksums and a PGP-signed manifest if you require additional verification. For X.509 signatures we can include the signing cert chain in the manifest and a detached signature (PKCS#7).

Redaction: By default we will redact plain email addresses for events older than 90 days and include hashed_email (sha256) and principal_id. If you need full PII we can provide an encrypted, controlled extract under a separate upload policy and NDA addendum.

Timeline:
- Monday 2026-06-22: we prepare staging bundles and run integrity checks (internal).
- Tuesday 2026-06-23 14:00 PT: alignment call (Logan/Kimberly + Audrey + MedicoSys Compliance).
- Wednesday 2026-06-24 10:00 PT: presigned URLs delivered, with checksums and signed manifest.

Action items: 
- Audrey: confirm staging bucket ARN and whether auditor wants PKCS#7 or PGP detached signatures.
- Logan: run sampling job and send estimate of final compressed size (by EOD Monday).
- Kimberly: produce signing cert metadata and prepare manifest template for Tuesday's call.

Attachments included: admin-activity-manifest.csv.gz, signed-manifest.sha256, export-sample-mapping.csv

Thanks — we’ll be ready for the call.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Technical Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: admin-activity-manifest.csv.gz]
